description: Defines the base class QuicSpdyClientBase for a QUIC client that handles HTTP/2 (SPDY) requests over QUIC, including response handling, request sending, and session management.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientBase
classes.description: A base class for a QUIC client supporting HTTP/2, managing sessions, requests, responses, and resending data.

classes.name: ResponseListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications when a complete response is received.

classes.name: QuicDataToResend
classes.description: Abstract class representing data that can be resent over a QUIC connection.

classes.name: ClientQuicDataToResend
classes.description: Concrete implementation of QuicDataToResend for client-specific data resending.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with server info, supported versions, config, helper, and session cache.

methods.name: ~QuicSpdyClientBase
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure events.

methods.name: InitializeSession
methods.description: Initializes the session, including crypto handshake.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP/2 request without waiting for response.

methods.name: SendRequestAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP/2 request and waits for response.

methods.name: SendRequestsAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Sends multiple requests and waits for each to complete.

methods.name: CreateClientStream
methods.description: Creates a new client stream.

methods.name: client_session
methods.description: Returns the current client session.

methods.name: push_promise_index
methods.description: Access to the push promise index.

methods.name: CheckVary
methods.description: Checks Vary headers for cache validation.

methods.name: OnRendezvousResult
methods.description: Handles rendezvous results for streams.

methods.name: MaybeAddQuicDataToResend
methods.description: Queues data to resend if handshake not confirmed.

methods.name: set_store_response
methods.description: Enables storing latest response data.

methods.name: latest_response_code
methods.description: Returns the latest response code.

methods.name: latest_response_headers
methods.description: Returns the latest response headers.

methods.name: preliminary_response_headers
methods.description: Returns preliminary response headers.

methods.name: latest_response_header_block
methods.description: Returns latest response header block.

methods.name: latest_response_body
methods.description: Returns latest response body.

methods.name: latest_response_trailers
methods.description: Returns latest response trailers.

methods.name: set_response_listener
methods.description: Sets the response listener.

methods.name: set_drop_response_body
methods.description: Configures whether to drop response bodies.

methods.name: drop_response_body
methods.description: Checks if response bodies are dropped.

methods.name: set_enable_web_transport
methods.description: Enables WebTransport.

methods.name: enable_web_transport
methods.description: Checks if WebTransport is enabled.

methods.name: set_use_datagram_contexts
methods.description: Configures use of datagram contexts.

methods.name: use_datagram_contexts
methods.description: Checks if datagram contexts are used.

methods.name: goaway_received
methods.description: Checks if GOAWAY received.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if inchoate reject was received.

methods.name: set_max_inbound_header_list_size
methods.description: Sets maximum inbound header list size.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellosFromSession
methods.description: Returns number of client hellos sent.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdatesFromSession
methods.description: Returns number of server config updates received.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client session.

methods.name: ClearDataToResend
methods.description: Clears queued data to resend.

methods.name: ResendSavedData
methods.description: Resends queued data.

methods.name: AddPromiseDataToResend
methods.description: Adds promise data to resend queue.

methods.name: HasActiveRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are active requests.

methods.name: ClientQuicDataToResend
methods.description: Resend data specific to client, implements Resend().

methods.name: SendRequestInternal
methods.description: Internal method to send a request.
